_note: 3권(짝꿍 숲) 새 대본. 유닛 = 독립 4컷, 컷당 한 문장(그 유닛 짝꿍 소리 단어 + 사이트워드). 핌과 팜(twins)은 늘 붙어 다니는 쌍둥이 파랑새 친구로만. {TWINS} {BEADS} 사용 가능.
setting: A frame from a 3D animated film set in a friendly storybook forest: tall rounded trees, a mossy path, a wooden footbridge over a stream, mushrooms and ferns, dappled soft light, limited palette of forest green, moss, warm brown and sky blue.

panels.desc: {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} step out of the garden onto a forest path; tall trees arch overhead.
Two tiny bluebirds, {TWINS}, sit side by side on one branch above the path, both opening their beaks at the same time.
panels.text: Hi! We are Pim and Pam.

panels.desc: {TWINS} fly a loop together in perfect sync; {PIP} tries to follow and tumbles in the air; {BUN} and {HED} laugh.
{TWINS} land one on each of Pip's shoulders; the three birds grin; {BUN} and {HED} wave.
By the forest stream, {HED} holds a white dish and {BUN} a toy ship; {fish} swims in the shallow water. A small shed stands behind them.
panels.text: She has a dish. He has a ship.

panels.desc: {BUN} floats the ship on the stream; {fish} pushes the ship along with its nose; {PIP} rides on the ship.
panels.text: The fish can push the ship!

panels.desc: The ship bumps the dish; a big splash; {HED} is soaked; a shell lands on his head.
{GRUMBLE} pokes his head out of a hollow log with a finger on his lips; {fish} hides in the dish. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} freeze.
panels.text: Shh! The fish is in the dish.

panels.desc: {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} sit on a wooden bench in the forest with a lunch box of chips; a chess board sits beside them.
panels.text: They have lunch on the bench.

panels.desc: {chimp} swings down from a branch and grabs a chip, chomping it; {HED} covers the box.
panels.text: A chimp! It was my chip!

panels.desc: {chimp} rubs its chin thinking, then offers {HED} a shiny chess piece in return. {BUN} smiles.
{chimp} and {HED} play chess on the bench; {PIP} and {BUN} share the chips; everyone is happy.
A very thin forest path between two big rocks; {HED} is too round to fit; {PIP} and {BUN} are through already.
{HED} pushes with his thumb against the rock; {BUN} pulls his paw; {PIP} pushes from behind.
{HED} pops through and rolls into a shallow mud bath puddle with a splash; {moth} flutters up.
{HED} sits muddy and grinning; {moth} rests on his nose; {PIP} and {BUN} laugh.
{duck} wears a small golden crown and looks under a rock for something; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} come to help. A sock and a lock lie on the path.
panels.text: What are you doing, King Duck?

panels.desc: {duck} points at his wing and then at the ground: a ring is missing. {HED} looks closely.
panels.text: A ring? Where is the ring?

panels.desc: {PIP} sings loudly from a branch; birds sing back from the trees; a crow flies by with something shiny.
A small bird drops the golden ring onto the duck king's wing; {duck} dances; {BUN} and {HED} clap.
panels.text: The ring is on the wing!

panels.desc: {TWINS} sit on a log with {PIP} between them; {BUN} and {HED} watch from the grass.
panels.text: Pim and Pam sit with Pip.

panels.desc: {TWINS} open their beaks together, making a quiet hushing shape; {PIP} copies with its wing on its beak.
{PIP} points at the stream where {fish} jumps and shouts; {duck} with a crown looks over.
{TWINS}, {BUN} and {HED} cheer; {duck} bows to {PIP}; the fish splashes happily.
{BUN} stacks colored wooden blocks on a tree stump; the top one is a black block; a clock hangs on the tree. A flag flutters on a stick.
{HED} claps; the stack wobbles; {PIP} flaps to hold it.
The black block falls into the stream and lands on {clam}, which snaps its shell shut on it.
{clam} opens with the black block inside like a pearl; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} peer in, delighted.
{crab} sits in a tiny wooden crib by the stream, crying; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} tiptoe up. A brick path leads to it.
panels.text: A crab is in the crib.

panels.desc: {BUN} plays a drum gently; {crab} stops crying and listens. {HED} holds a brush.
{HED} brushes the crab's shell; the crab smiles; there is a crack in the crib's rail.
{PIP} ties a little dress of leaves around the crib rail to fix the crack; {crab} sleeps; everyone whispers.
panels.text: The crab sleeps with the drum.

panels.desc: A rope swing hangs from a big tree; {HED} sits on it holding a snack bag; {PIP} and {BUN} push.
{BUN} pushes hard; the swing flies high; the snack bag spills; a stick and a stack of crackers fly out.
Crackers rain down into the stream; {GRUMBLE} below sniffs the air; a spot of jam lands on his nose.
{GRUMBLE} swims in the stream catching crackers; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} laugh from the swing.
panels.text: Grumble can swim for one snack!

panels.desc: {chimp} has set up a camp tent by the pond in the forest; a lamp glows; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} arrive with a plant.
{ant} carries a stamp into the tent; a line of ants follows across the sand; {HED} points.
{chimp} hands the ants a chest of crumbs; the ants nest in a vest on the ground; {BUN} laughs.
panels.text: What do ants do? They eat!

panels.desc: Night: everyone sleeps in the tent by the lamp; the ants sleep in the vest; {PIP} sleeps on the chimp's head.
At the end of the forest path stands a tall wooden door; {PIP}, {BUN}, {HED} and {TWINS} look up at it. A whisk and a quilt lie on a bench.
{duck} with a crown pops out from behind the door with a loud quack; everyone jumps.
panels.text: Quack! Where did you come from?

panels.desc: {duck} opens the door quickly; behind it is a castle on a hill, far away. {TWINS} gasp together.
Everyone walks through the door toward the castle; {PIP} waves goodbye to the forest; a quill feather floats down.
Lanterns in the forest trees; a long table on the footbridge; {PIP}, {BUN}, {HED} and {TWINS} set out a dish, chips and a drum.
Guests arrive: {fish} in a bowl carried by {chimp}, {duck} with a crown, {crab}. {HED} waves them in.
{GRUMBLE} arrives on the rope swing, swinging over the table; everyone ducks; a snack flies.
Everyone dances on the bridge; {TWINS} sing together; {GRUMBLE} taps the drum with a tiny smile.
A stage between two trees with a leaf curtain; {PIP} wears a top hat; {TWINS} hold the curtain.
{fish} in a bowl, {chimp} and {duck} each hold a blank white card; {BUN} and {HED} present them.
{GRUMBLE} holds two cards stuck together and tries to pull them apart; the audience giggles.
{TWINS} pull the two cards apart together; {GRUMBLE} laughs out loud for the first time; everyone cheers.
